sentences.text: The 2022 World Cup final: Argentina against France, three-all, then Argentina won on penalties.
Argentina began in a four-three-three, France in a four-two-three-one.
In the first forty minutes, Argentina completed two hundred and thirty passes to France's one hundred and sixteen.
By the seventy-eighth minute, Argentina had ten shots.
France had two, the first in the sixty-seventh minute.
Then France scored twice in two minutes.
Over the whole match, expected goals ended nearly level: two point eight to two point three.
